name: Classic Round Natural Diamond Split Shank Ring
subtitle: 1 or 2 CT Natural Round Brilliant · 14K White Gold
summary: A 1.00 or 2.00 ct round brilliant natural diamond in a delicate 14K white gold split-shank setting, with natural pavé diamonds along the shoulders.
description:
A classic round brilliant natural diamond set in high-polish 14K white gold, with slender split-shank shoulders lined with natural pavé diamonds.

The 1.00 ct option is $10,450 CAD. We’ll discuss the centre diamond’s specifications based on availability.

The 2.00 ct option is $17,000 CAD. The centre diamond is offered in the D–E colourless range with VS clarity. Approximately 0.30–0.50 ct of natural pavé diamonds bring the total to 2.30–2.50 ct. Exact colour, clarity and grading report are confirmed with the selected diamond. Band diamond weight may vary slightly with ring size.

The separate band shown in the supplied styling photos is not included.
